data.question: Do shared versus duplicated serialized expression DAGs change checking on three small conversion terms?
data.versions: Retained LazyLean Darwin binary, Python 3.10; current session model with two bounded delegates for separate trials.
data.sample: beta, zeta and nested-beta conversion terms x shared/duplicated representations x subst/KAM-mode-3 = twelve cells. All declaration expression roots expand identically between each pair.
data.controls: Both representations must ACCEPT with positive conversion demand. Structural expansion equality is checked before launch. A recognized profile/pair semantic difference is a candidate signal; failed controls or missing demand is INCONCLUSIVE. Loader interns duplicated terms, so no preserved internal sharing or general memory/performance comparison is claimed.
